$comment: What a session may owe the house when it ends, read by core/lib/gate.js. An obligation is owed when a changed path matches one of its triggers and no changed path lies under its folder (the place that receives it). A trigger ending in / matches everything under that folder, any other trigger matches one exact path, and the trigger "work" matches any changed path outside record_folders and outside every other trigger of every obligation (a constitution file owes its own obligation, not a task and a state note), including paths outside the house. Paths are house-relative with forward slashes.

obligations.owed: regenerate the projections with lampstand compile: the constitution changed and .house/generated/ did not
record the session's work in tasks/: update the task it served, or resolve it with a resolution
update state/current.md with the standing reality the session changed
